risk_reasons: Touches worker/background/pollers/OutboxPoller.ts — the dispatch path every async workflow in RepWorth depends on
Changes a terminal state transition on job_outbox, governed by invariant #2 (transactional outbox)
A false-positive terminalization would mark genuinely in-flight work 'failed'
goal: The Watchdog terminalizes a stale 'dispatching' Outbox job that has exhausted its attempts on every topic, not only agent_turn, so a crash between the claim and runOutboxDispatchFailure can no longer strand a row in a state no arm and no claim can select.
non_goals: Changing arm 3's 2-minute re-pend window, or the OUTBOX_WATCHDOG_STALE_MS default itself
Making reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox topic-agnostic — it stays Operator-specific, guarded by its own `AND topic = AGENT_TURN` re-select at turns.ts:58
Removing the array_agg(...) FILTER — it is a redundant pre-filter, kept as an optimization, but it is NOT the safety boundary (see deviations D6)
Changing claimPendingBatch, markDispatched, or the dispatch path
Backfilling existing orphans — production and staging were both queried at 2026-09-20 and hold zero matching rows
Lowering HEALTH_ALERT_FAILED_THRESHOLD — opening the topic allowlist does not change the per-topic bar
user_visible_behavior: A 'dispatching' job_outbox row at attempts >= max_attempts whose dispatched_at is NULL or older than watchdogStaleSecs (15 min) becomes status='failed' with completed_at set, on any topic, within one watchdog cycle.
A 'dispatching' row at max_attempts aged between 2 and 15 minutes is left alone — arm 3's re-pend window does not terminalize.
The '[OutboxPoller] Watchdog recovered stale entries' log line's `failed` count now includes such rows on non-agent_turn topics.
The outbox_stale_dispatching finding, which an orphan otherwise raises forever under the misleading title 'OutboxPoller watchdog may be down', now clears on the next cycle.
checkFailedOutboxByTopic now raises outbox_failed:<topic> for EVERY topic over threshold, not only the previous seven — so the terminal path the watchdog opened has an alert half.
invariants: Invariant #2: the in-flight status set ('pending','dispatching','dispatched') owned by src/lib/shared/job-outbox-status.ts is not referenced or re-spelled by this change; ci:outbox-status stays green.
reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox acts only on rows whose topic is QUEUE_NAMES.AGENT_TURN, enforced by its own re-select at turns.ts:58.

A row claimed less than watchdogStaleSecs (15 min) ago is never terminalized, whatever its attempts — the window must stay strictly greater than the worst-case claim-to-dispatched gap of (topics x OUTBOX_DISPATCH_TIMEOUT_MS).
The #736 last_error preservation (COALESCE(NULLIF(last_error, ''), ...)) holds for both the dispatched and the dispatching branch.
Arm 2 (terminalize) and arm 3 (re-pend) stay mutually exclusive by the attempts predicate, so no row is both terminalized and re-pended in one transaction.
Every topic with a terminal outbox path has an alert that can fire for it.
edge_cases: dispatched_at IS NULL is treated as stale by BOTH dispatching arms, though they pair that disjunct with different intervals.

A row at attempts >= max_attempts aged between arm 3's 2 minutes and the terminal arm's 15 minutes matches NEITHER arm and is deliberately left in 'dispatching' — that gap is where a live serial dispatch cycle sits.
An agent_turn row keeps its existing route through reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox, including the 'deferred' outcome that rolls the row back to 'dispatched' and subtracts from terminatedCount.
A terminalized dispatching row with NULL or empty last_error receives 'Stale dispatching entry exceeded max_attempts'; one carrying a bounded error class keeps it.
A dispatching row on a topic the queue registry does not know is still terminalized — the watchdog is deliberately topic-blind.
Opening the alert allowlist cannot lower the bar for the original seven topics: failedThreshold is applied per topic after the GROUP BY.

worker/background/pollers/__tests__/OutboxPoller.watchdog.integration.test.ts — the live-DB seam, PROBE_TOPIC fixture, seedRow/rowState helpers and interval-based ageing
worker/background/pollers/__tests__/OutboxPoller.operator.integration.test.ts — the agent_turn terminalizer's live-DB coverage that must stay green

rollback_plan: Revert the branch's commits. No schema or data migration is involved, so the revert is complete. Rows the widened arm already terminalized stay 'failed'; they were permanently unrecoverable before the change, so leaving them terminal is the desired end state and needs no compensating write. Reverting also restores the seven-topic alert allowlist, which is safe because the terminal path those ~30 topics gained disappears with it.
observability: Structured log '[OutboxPoller] Watchdog recovered stale entries' — the `failed` field counts the new terminalizations; covered by a test.
HealthAlertPoller finding outbox_stale_dispatching (HEALTH_ALERT_STALE_DISPATCHING_S, default 600s) clears instead of firing permanently.

HealthAlertPoller finding outbox_failed:<topic> now covers every topic, closing the gap the first draft of this change would have opened — a watchdog-terminated row fires no BullMQ 'failed' event, so the Job-failure sink never sees it and this alert is the only signal.
